checks.summary: A page carries the evaluation watermark that an Aspose product (PDF, Cells, Words or Slides) saving without a license stamped into the file; a license does not remove it.
A font the document uses is unavailable or substituted, so the rendering may differ from the author's.
Font resources other than the standard 14 PDF fonts are not embedded, so rendering can vary between machines.
The document contains form fields whose rendered appearances must be inspected for stale, clipped or missing values.
Form fields cannot be associated with a valid page of the document.
A page is narrower or shorter than 72 pt, or wider or taller than 2880 pt, and may preview poorly.
A page carries very little readable text and no images covering a quarter of it, which may indicate an unintended sparse page or pagination break.
A page has no readable text, no images covering a quarter of it and does not look scanned, so it may be unintentionally blank.
A page has no extractable text and an image fills its width or height, as on a scan, so search and redact_text do not reach its content.
Text extraction reached its budget, so the structural text checks of a page are incomplete.
Text lies under an opaque box painted over it, such as a redaction cover, so it is in the file but not visible on the page.
Text fragments extend beyond the page rectangle and may be clipped.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

output.description: The PDF written; absent for a dry run, which writes nothing.

dryRun.description: Whether the batch was only checked and applied in memory (--dry-run).

applied.description: The outcome of each operation, in batch order.

backup.description: The copy of the input kept before it was replaced in place; absent otherwise.

pagesTouched.description: The 1-based pages the operations changed; absent when they changed none.

verification.description: Present with --verify: the staged output read back against the effect of each form, redaction, bookmark, property, attachment and page operation.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

ok.description: Whether the verification found no issue.

issues.description: The problems found, empty when ok is true.

checkedOps.description: In batch order, the ids of the operations whose effect the verification read back from the staged output; an operation left out was not checked.

what.description: What was extracted, as --what named it.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

pdfPageOutput.description: One file a command wrote, and the page of the PDF it holds when it holds one.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 identity of the published file.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

page.description: The 1-based page the file holds or comes from; absent when it holds no single page, as a whole-document file, an attachment or form data does.

v2/pdf/inspect-result.description: Structural information returned by pdf inspect.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

pdf.description: The document summary every inspection reports.

pages.description: The first pages' geometry with --sample; a LIST_TRUNCATED warning names the page count when there are more.

pageLabels.description: The page-label ranges, when the file has any.

outline.description: Bookmarks in reading order, depth first, with --detail outline; a LIST_TRUNCATED warning names the total when there are more.

links.description: The links to web addresses in page order, with --detail links; a LIST_TRUNCATED warning names the total when there are more.

forms.description: The interactive form and its fields' values, with --detail forms.

fonts.description: The distinct font resources, with --detail fonts.

permissions.description: The passwords and permissions, with --detail permissions.

layers.description: The names of the optional content layers, with --detail layers.

properties.description: Document information and XMP properties as the file stores them, with --detail properties; a custom document information entry keeps its own key (info: before it when it spells a reported name), and XMP keys start with xmp:. creationDate and modificationDate are ISO 8601 with a fraction of a second only when it is not zero, as XMP writes dates (2026-10-01T06:01:53Z): in UTC ending in Z when the stored date states an offset, without Z when it states none, and the stored text unchanged when it is not a PDF date.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

name.description: The attachment's file name, which delete_attachment accepts.

mimeType.description: The attachment's media type; absent when the file does not state one.

sizeBytes.description: The attachment's size in bytes; absent when the file does not state it.

description.description: The attachment's description; absent when the file states none.

name.description: The font's name as the file stores it.

embedded.description: Whether the font program is embedded in the file.

subset.description: Whether only the glyphs the document uses are embedded.

pdfFormField.description: One form field; a radio group is one field, however many buttons it has.

name.description: The field's full name, which set_form_field accepts.

kind.description: The field kind, such as text, checkbox or radio.

value.description: The field's value; for a radio group, the value of its selected button.

options.description: The values set_form_field accepts for the field: a choice field's or a radio group's values, or a check box's appearance states, Off first; absent for a field that takes any text.

readOnly.description: Whether the field cannot be filled.

required.description: Whether the form requires a value for the field.

page.description: The page of the field's widget; absent for a radio group, whose buttons each have their own, for a field without a widget, and in evaluation mode for a widget past the pages the engine shows, which EVALUATION_INPUT_TRUNCATED then discloses.

rect.description: The field's widget on that page, in points from its top-left corner. Present only with page.

pdfFormInfo.description: The document's interactive form and its fields.

kind.description: The kind of form, an AcroForm or an XFA form; absent when the file has none.

fieldCount.description: The number of field names, so a radio group is one field however many buttons it has; review counts fields the same way.

readOnly.description: Whether the form's fields cannot be filled.

fields.description: The first fields in order of their names, one per field name; a LIST_TRUNCATED warning names fieldCount when there are more.

pdfLinkInfo.description: One link to a web address.

page.description: The 1-based page the link is on.

rect.description: The link's area on its page, in points from the top-left corner of the visible page.

url.description: The web address the link opens.

pdfOutlineItem.description: One bookmark of the document's outline.

level.description: The bookmark's depth: 1 for a top-level bookmark.

bookmark.description: The bookmark's address: its 1-based positions from the top level down, joined by '/', so 2/1 is the first child of the second top-level bookmark. delete_bookmarks.bookmarks and add_bookmark.parent take it.

page.description: The page the bookmark opens; omitted when its destination is not a page of the document.

pdfPageInfo.description: One page's stable geometry in PDF points.

page.description: The 1-based page number that operations address.

pageSize.description: The size of the visible page, as insert_page and set_page_size set it.

rotation.description: Clockwise page rotation in degrees, a quarter turn at a time: 0, 90, 180 or 270.

mediaBox.description: The page's media box, the full physical page as it is seen, with the page's rotation: the frame the crop box is measured in, so it is always at 0,0.

cropBox.description: The page's crop box, the region a viewer shows, in points from the top-left corner of the media box as it is seen, with the page's rotation, as crop_pages measures.

pdfPageLabelInfo.description: One page-label range, addressed by its 1-based starting page.

startPage.description: The 1-based page the range starts at.

numberStyle.description: How the label numbers are written, one of the values set_page_labels accepts.

prefix.description: The text put before each label's number; absent when there is none.

startingValue.description: The number the range's first page shows.

pdfPageSizeSummary.description: One distinct page size and how many pages of the document have it.

pageSize.description: The size of the visible page.

pageCount.description: How many pages have this size.

pdfPermissionInfo.description: The passwords and permissions of an opened PDF.

hasOpenPassword.description: Whether the file needs a password to open.

hasOwnerPassword.description: Whether the file has an owner password, which lifts its permissions; it may also be the open password, as --encrypt writes it.

ownerAccess.description: Whether this run may change the file regardless of its permissions: it is not encrypted or was opened with the owner password. The permissions below still state what the file grants readers.

print.description: Whether the file lets readers print it. Like every permission below, this is what the file grants anyone without the owner password, whatever password this run used; true for a file that is not encrypted.

copy.description: Whether the file lets readers copy or extract its text and images.

modify.description: Whether the file lets readers change its content.

annotate.description: Whether the file lets readers add or change annotations and fill form fields.

fillForms.description: Whether the file lets readers fill its form fields, even when annotate is false.

extractAccessibility.description: Whether the file lets accessibility tools extract its text and images.

assemble.description: Whether the file lets readers insert, delete, rotate and move pages and create bookmarks.

printHighResolution.description: Whether the file lets readers print it at full quality; when false and print is true, printing may be degraded.

pdfRect.description: A rectangle in points from the top-left corner of the page.

x.description: Distance of the left edge from the page's left edge.

y.description: Distance of the top edge from the page's top edge.

valid.description: Whether the signature verifies against the signed bytes; absent when it was not verified.

linearized.description: Whether the file is linearized for fast web view.

tagged.description: Whether the file is tagged, with a logical structure for accessibility.

pdfaProfile.description: The PDF/A profile the file declares in its metadata, such as pdfa-2b; absent when it declares none. A declaration is not a check: pdf validate --profile verifies conformance.

attachmentCount.description: How many files are embedded in the document.

signed.description: Whether the file has a signed signature field.

passwordType.description: The password this run opened the file with: user for the open password, owner for the owner password, also when it is the open password too; absent when it needed none (an unencrypted file, or one with only an owner password). permissions.hasOpenPassword and hasOwnerPassword state which passwords the file has.

v2/pdf/ops.description: The operation document of pdf edit --ops. Page numbers and ranges are 1-based and resolve against the document as the earlier operations left it. Operations apply in order. Without --best-effort the batch is atomic: if any operation fails, no file is written. With --best-effort the operations that succeed are kept and saved, each one that fails is reported, and the command exits 8 when any failed; an invalid document or a failure inside the document engine still writes nothing. The bare array of operations is accepted as the document with only its ops. Each operation field's x-readBack says whether it is state the operation writes and where a read reports it: a read result's schema URI with a JSON Pointer to the property that reports the field, where a pointer ending in a dictionary's additionalProperties is the entry named after the field; unread for state no read reports yet; position for state a read reports by position rather than by name, such as cell values; not-state for a selector, a source or a parameter of the action.

ifMatch.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint the input must still have; the edit fails when it changed.

id.description: A correlation id echoed in the result; op-0001 style ids are assigned when omitted.

add_attachment.description: Embeds a file as a document attachment.

path.description: The file, relative to the working directory.

name.description: The stable attachment name; the file name when omitted, never its local path.

description.description: A description of the attachment that viewers show beside its name; none when omitted.

mimeType.description: The media type stored with the attachment, such as "image/png", which archives and viewers read to identify it and PDF/A-3 keeps; none when omitted.

add_bookmark.description: Adds a bookmark that opens a page.

title.description: The bookmark's title; it must not contain '/', which joins the positions of a bookmark address.

parent.description: The parent bookmark, as pdf inspect --detail outline reports it: 1-based positions joined by '/', so "2/1" is the first child of the second top-level bookmark. The new bookmark is appended after the parent's existing children, or after the existing top-level bookmarks when omitted, so no existing bookmark address changes.

add_footer_text.description: Stamps text in the bottom margin of pages.

pages.description: The pages to stamp; every page when omitted.

placement.description: Where in the bottom margin the text sits; a top placement puts it in the top margin instead.

font.description: An installed font name; the default font when omitted.

add_header_text.description: Stamps text in the top margin of pages.

pages.description: The pages to stamp; every page when omitted.

placement.description: Where in the top margin the text sits; a bottom placement puts it in the bottom margin instead.

font.description: An installed font name; the default font when omitted.

add_hyperlink.description: Adds a clickable link area to one page.

page.description: The 1-based page that gets the link.

add_page_numbers.description: Stamps page numbers in a page margin.

pages.description: The pages to number; every page when omitted.

text.description: The text; {n} is the number, counted over the selected pages from start, and {N} the document's page count.

placement.description: The margin corner or center the number sits in.

start.description: The number of the first selected page.

font.description: An installed font name; the default font when omitted.

add_stamp_image.description: Stamps an image into a rectangle of one page.

path.description: The image, relative to the working directory; an SVG must not reference network resources.

rect.description: The rectangle the image is drawn into.

add_watermark_image.description: Stamps an image across the middle of pages.

pages.description: The pages to stamp; every page when omitted.

path.description: The image, relative to the working directory; an SVG must not reference network resources.

opacity.description: How opaque the watermark is, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

scalePercent.description: The size of the image as a whole-number percentage of its own size, such as 50.

layer.description: Whether the watermark is drawn over the page content or under it, where opaque content hides it.

add_watermark_text.description: Stamps text across the middle of pages.

pages.description: The pages to stamp; every page when omitted.

text.description: The watermark text, such as CONFIDENTIAL.

font.description: An installed font name; the default font when omitted.

opacity.description: How opaque the watermark is, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

rotation.description: The angle in degrees, clockwise; the default -45 rises from the bottom left to the top right.

layer.description: Whether the watermark is drawn over the page content or under it, where opaque content hides it.

clear_properties.description: Clears the document properties: the document information entries and the XMP metadata.

xmp.description: Whether the XMP metadata stream is removed.

documentInfo.description: Whether the document information dictionary is cleared.

crop_pages.description: Crops pages to a rectangle measured on each page's visible page box before the crop, from its top-left corner; 'pdf inspect --sample' reports the resulting page size and the crop box, measured from the top-left corner of the media box as it is seen.

box.description: The page box to set: the visible crop box or the physical media box.

rect.description: The part of the visible page before the crop to keep, from its top-left corner.

decrypt_document.description: Removes the document's encryption; an unencrypted document is unchanged.

delete_attachment.description: Deletes a document attachment by name.

name.description: The attachment name, as pdf inspect --detail attachments reports it.

delete_bookmarks.description: Deletes the listed bookmarks with their children, or every bookmark when none are listed. A bookmark must not repeat or lie inside another listed bookmark, which already deletes its children.

bookmarks.description: The bookmarks, as pdf inspect --detail outline reports them: 1-based positions joined by '/', so "2/1" is the first child of the second top-level bookmark; every bookmark when omitted. Every address resolves against the outline as it stands before this operation, so their order does not matter, and all of them are deleted together; later operations in the batch address the renumbered outline.

delete_pages.description: Deletes pages; a PDF must keep at least one page.

encrypt_document.description: Encrypts the document with AES-256; the published file needs the user password to open when one is set.

userPasswordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password to open the document; anyone can open it when omitted.

ownerPasswordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the owner password, which grants every permission.

permissions.description: What a reader may do without the owner password; every permission is denied when omitted.

flatten_forms.description: Flattens form fields into page content: the named fields, or every field.

fields.description: The full names of the fields to flatten, each with every widget of the name, such as all buttons of a radio group; every field when omitted.

path.description: The source PDF, relative to the working directory.

pages.description: The source pages; every page when omitted.

at.description: The 1-based position of the first inserted page, at most the page count plus one.

sourcePasswordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the source PDF's password.

at.description: The 1-based position of the new page, at most the page count plus one.

pageSize.description: The size of the new page; an a4 page when omitted.

move_pages.description: Moves pages so the first of them lands at a position of the current document.

to.description: The 1-based position, counted before the move, at most the page count plus one.

optimize_document.description: Optimizes the document's resources; image options recompress images.

downsampleImagesDpi.description: The largest image resolution kept, in dots per inch.

imageQuality.description: The JPEG quality of recompressed images.

unembedFonts.description: Whether embedded fonts are removed, so a reader without them installed substitutes others.

removeUnusedObjects.description: Whether resources, such as images, that a page lists but its content never draws are removed. Every edit leaves out the objects that nothing in the document references.

compressStreams.description: Whether content streams are compressed and objects packed into compressed object streams.

redact_area.description: Redacts a rectangle of one page.

rect.description: The area whose content is removed.

fillColor.description: The color of the box that covers the redacted area.

redact_text.description: Redacts every match of a text pattern in the extractable text; it does not perform OCR. A regular expression runs with a one-second timeout and must not match an empty string.

find.description: The text to find. Literal text also matches with up to two spaces, never a line break, where an East Asian character meets a character that is not East Asian, such as a digit or Latin letter, as extracted text can hold there.

regex.description: Whether find is a .NET regular expression rather than literal text.

caseSensitive.description: Whether find matches only text in the same case; any case matches when omitted.

pages.description: The pages to search; every page when omitted.

fillColor.description: The color of the box that covers each redacted match.

rotate_pages.description: Rotates pages to an absolute angle.

rotation.description: The rotation in degrees, clockwise, a quarter turn at a time: 0, 90, 180 or 270; 0 sets a page upright.

set_form_field.description: Sets the value of one form field, named by its full name. A push button or a signature field holds no value and is refused: place an image with add_stamp_image, and sign with 'aspose-cli pdf sign'.

name.description: The field's full name, as pdf inspect --detail forms reports it, such as applicant.name.

value.description: The value to set; null clears the field: a radio group selects no button, a check box is unchecked and any other field is emptied.

set_page_labels.description: Sets page-label ranges, which change navigation labels, not visible page text; each start page appears once.

ranges.description: The label ranges, each applying from its start page until the next one starts.

set_page_size.description: Sets pages to a page size.

pageSize.description: The new page size, a preset or a width and height in points.

scaleContent.description: Whether the content is scaled to the new size rather than kept at its position.

set_properties.description: Sets document information entries; omitted entries keep their values.

keywords.description: The document keywords, as one text such as "budget, 2026".

custom.description: Custom document information entries by name, which pdf inspect --detail properties reports under the same names. A name must not be empty, hold characters beyond Latin-1, be one of the standard entries, which the fields above or the engine set, in any case, nor start with info: or xmp:.

pageSizeInput.description: The size of a page in points (72 per inch) as an operation sets it: a preset, in portrait, or both the width and the height. A read reports it as a page size under the same names, with the preset the dimensions match, and writes back as it reads: given with the width and height, the preset must be the paper they measure in either orientation, and the width and height apply.

preset.description: The preset, in portrait; with the width and height, the paper they measure.

width.description: The page width in points, given with the height.

height.description: The page height in points, given with the width.

pages.description: 1-based numbers and ranges separated by commas, such as 1-3,7,9-; a range with no end runs to the last one, and a range must not end before it starts.

pdfPageLabelRange.description: One page-label range, which applies from its start page until the next range.

startPage.description: The 1-based page where the range starts.

numberStyle.description: How the label numbers are written; none labels the pages with the prefix alone.

prefix.description: Text placed before each label value.

startingValue.description: The label value of the start page.

pdfPermissionsInput.description: What a reader may do without the owner password; everything omitted is denied.

print.description: Whether the document may be printed, at low resolution unless printHighResolution is also allowed.

copy.description: Whether text and images may be copied out of the document.

modify.description: Whether the content may be changed, other than by annotate, fillForms or assemble.

annotate.description: Whether comments and other annotations may be added or changed, and form fields filled.

fillForms.description: Whether existing form fields may be filled in and signed.

extractAccessibility.description: Whether text and images may be extracted for accessibility, such as by a screen reader.

assemble.description: Whether pages may be inserted, deleted or rotated and bookmarks and thumbnails created.

printHighResolution.description: Whether the document may be printed at full quality; it takes effect only with print.

pdfRectInput.description: A rectangle in points (72 per inch) with a top-left origin, relative to the visible, rotated page box.

width.description: The width, to the right of x.

webLink.description: An absolute http://, https:// or mailto: URL.

v2/pdf/read-result.description: Windowed page text returned by pdf read.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

content.description: What was returned of each page, as --content chose: text in reading order, or layout, which keeps the page's spacing.

pageCount.description: How many pages the document has, whatever --pages selected.

pages.description: The text of each page in the window, in page order.

scannedPagesSuspected.description: The pages of the window that have no extractable text and appear image-dominated, so they are probably scanned; absent when there are none.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

pdfPageText.description: The text of one PDF page.

page.description: The 1-based page number that operations address.

truncated.description: Whether the text was cut to stay within --max-chars.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: Each written image and the page it shows, in page order.

dpi.description: The resolution raster images were rendered at; absent for SVG.

grid.description: The coordinate grid drawn on every output image, present only when one was requested.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

pdfPageOutput.description: One file a command wrote, and the page of the PDF it holds when it holds one.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 identity of the published file.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

page.description: The 1-based page the file holds or comes from; absent when it holds no single page, as a whole-document file, an attachment or form data does.

pdfRenderGrid.description: A coordinate grid drawn on rendered images, in the coordinates redact_area takes: points from the top-left corner of the visible, rotated page box.

spacing.description: Distance between grid lines, in points.

labelSpacing.description: Distance between the heavier, labelled lines, in points.

unit.description: The unit of the distances and labels: always pt.

origin.description: Where the coordinates start: always top-left.

v2/pdf/search-result.description: The bounded text search of pdf search.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

pattern.description: The text or regular expression searched for.

hits.description: Each match in the window, in page order.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

pdfRect.description: A rectangle in points from the top-left corner of the page.

x.description: Distance of the left edge from the page's left edge.

y.description: Distance of the top edge from the page's top edge.

pdfSearchHit.description: One match of a text search.

context.description: The page text around the match, up to 40 characters on each side, with line breaks as spaces and an ellipsis where it is cut; absent when the page's plain text does not show the hits the engine found, or when the text it pairs with this hit by order differs from the match (ignoring case).

rect.description: Where the match lies on its page.

occurrence.description: The match's 1-based position among the matches of the document.

v2/pdf/sign-result.description: Result of pdf sign: the signature applied and read back from the saved file.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

signature.description: The signature field as the saved file reports it.

visible.description: Whether the signature has a visible appearance on the page.

page.description: The 1-based page of the signature field.

rect.description: Where a visible signature lies on its page; absent for an invisible one.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

pdfRect.description: A rectangle in points from the top-left corner of the page.

x.description: Distance of the left edge from the page's left edge.

y.description: Distance of the top edge from the page's top edge.

pdfSignatureInfo.description: One signature field and the verification state the engine reports.

signed.description: Whether the field holds a signature.

valid.description: Whether the signature verifies against the signed bytes; absent when it was not verified.

v2/pdf/split-result.description: Result of pdf split, which writes every part or none.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: Each part written, in order; its number is the one in its file name.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

pdfPartOutput.description: The PDF written for one part of a split, and the pages of the source it holds.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 identity of the published file.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

pages.description: The source pages the part holds, as range text such as 1-3 or 1-3,7.

v2/pdf/validate-result.description: Result of pdf validate, a PDF/A conformance check.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

valid.description: Whether the file conforms to the profile.

issues.description: The first compliance issues; a LIST_TRUNCATED warning names the total when there are more.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

pdfComplianceIssue.description: One problem a PDF/A check found, with the clause of the standard it breaks; the details.problems of a failed PDF/A conversion lists the same objects.

code.description: What kind of issue this is: always PDFA_NONCONFORMANCE.

message.description: The problem as the engine states it.

clause.description: The clause of the PDF/A standard the problem breaks, such as 6.3.4; absent when the engine names none.

severity.description: How serious the engine rates the problem, such as error or warning.

page.description: The 1-based page the problem is on; absent when it concerns the whole document.

convertible.description: Whether pdf convert --to the profile can fix the problem.
